description: This source file implements SSO (Single Sign-On) management and authentication flows using FastAPI with multiple SSO providers (Google, Microsoft, generic OpenID). It handles creating redirect URLs for login, processing callback responses, managing user and team data synchronization with the database, health checks for SSO configuration, and CLI-specific SSO session handling. It defines handlers for various endpoints related to SSO login, callback, UI settings, and health, along with utility functions for token processing, user creation, and group validation.
